items.summary: Larry Berg will succeed Don Garber as new MLS commissioner beginning next year, but what exactly should the LAFC co-owner do to improve the league?

items.headline: NBPA opens 'one-stop shop' performance center in Los Angeles
items.summary: The National Basketball Players Association opened the PLYRS UNTD Performance Center in Los Angeles this week, offering a "one-stop shop" for league players to scrimmage, workout and recover.

items.headline: Inter Miami rues 6-game Leagues Cup ban for in-form Luis Suárez
items.summary: Inter Miami head coach Guillermo Hoyos said Luis Suárez cannot be replaced as the team prepares to navigate the Leagues Cup without the forward due to his lengthy suspension.

items.headline: Cape Verde coach Bubista steps down after historic World Cup campaign
items.summary: Cape Verde coach Bubista, who led the World Cup debutants to a stellar tournament, joined Moroccan club RS Berkane on Tuesday.

items.headline: First USMNT fixtures after new Mauricio Pochettino deal revealed
items.summary: The United States men's national team returns to action for the first time since the 2026 World Cup during the September/October FIFA international window, hosting Peru, Chile, Canada and Mexico in friendlies across the country.

items.headline: Kansas basketball to play in Players Era Festival through 2030-31
items.summary: Kansas has signed a five-year contract for the Jayhawks to participate in the Players Era Festival, which is expanding to 24 teams spanning two tournaments.

items.headline: Lionel Messi donates money to Madrid area damaged by wildfires
items.summary: Lionel Messi has donated money to help restore an area outside Madrid that has been affected by wildfires.

items.headline: No.1-ranked '28 player Williams will reclassify into 2027 class
items.summary: A.J. Williams, the No.1-ranked player in the class of 2028, plans to reclassify into the 2027 class, he told ESPN.

items.headline: Pochettino will now face a different pressure as USMNT boss
items.summary: Now that he has four years to plan for another World Cup, the demands on Mauricio Pochettino will be entirely different than what he has encountered so far.

items.headline: World Cup referee Anthony Taylor lands new role in Turkey
items.summary: English World Cup referee Anthony Taylor has taken up a post as director of elite refereeing with the Turkish Football Federation.
